items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: if Ike was playing, I'd make him play that... because I know it, just by the head, like, that we played it so much.

ctx.x: I talked over his... I was talking about Piku. Which wife was that the died?
Ike Roberson's wife. Oh, Ike Roberson. Yeah, his wife had three weeks ago. Oh yes, I remember.
